general: What problem are you solving and how big is that problem really?
Who exactly is your first paying customer?
What stops a bigger player from copying this in 6 months?
How do you acquire your first 100 customers?
What's the one metric that matters most right now, and why?
Why now — what's changed that makes this the right time?
market: How did you calculate your TAM — bottom-up or top-down?
Who are your top 3 competitors and why will you win?
Is this market growing or shrinking?
What's your realistic market share in 3 years, and how did you get that number?
What would have to be true for this market to be much bigger than you're claiming?
product: What's the MVP scope and why did you cut what you cut?
What's your tech stack and why that choice?
How do you handle scale if you 10x users overnight?
What's the hardest technical problem you still haven't solved?
How much of this could a competitor rebuild with off-the-shelf AI tools in a weekend?
financial: What's your burn rate and runway?
What are your unit economics — CAC vs LTV?
How much are you raising and what's it for specifically?
What's your path to profitability, and what has to happen to get there?
What are your assumptions most likely to be wrong about?
team: Why is this team the right team to build this?
What happens if a co-founder leaves?
What key hire do you need next, and why haven't you made it yet?
What's a mistake you've already made on this, and what did you learn?
saas: What's your churn rate assumption and why?
Why not just a plugin for an existing tool instead of a new platform?
What's your expansion revenue strategy — upsell, cross-sell, seat growth?
How sticky is this once a customer adopts it — what's the switching cost?
marketplace: How do you solve the chicken-and-egg problem — supply or demand first?
What's your take rate and is it sustainable?
What stops supply or demand from disintermediating you once trust is established?
How do you ensure quality/trust on both sides without heavy manual moderation?
mobile_app: Why would this not just be a feature inside a bigger app?
What's your organic vs paid acquisition split, and why?
How do you handle platform risk — App Store/Play Store policy changes?
consumer: What's your CAC and how does it compare to LTV?
Why will this not get commoditized by a bigger retailer?
What's your repeat purchase rate, and what drives it?
How defensible is this once a copycat undercuts you on price?
